metadata.title: Warrant: Reproducible Evaluation and Evidence Management for AI Detectors
metadata.description: Technical preprint, not peer reviewed. A local detector-evaluation toolkit, bounded empirical findings, adverse results and a claim/provenance audit. The native returned-bound interpretation and historical source gaps remain documented. No production or universal assurance claim is made.
metadata.notes: CC BY 4.0 covers the manuscript and LaTeX source. Software retains MIT and third-party inputs retain their own notices. No DOI is invented.
